lede: We play live. That sounds obvious, but it is the whole reason Relovation exists: a moment you see happen stays with you longer than a moment you only hear.
verhaal: Robin picked up the saxophone at eight and never put it down. In 2016 he met Lorenzo at an ensemble rehearsal, a pianist who astonished him from the very first note. Afterwards Robin asked him to play together. That is how it started.

They rehearsed in Lier, played here and there, and put on their first own concert in 2018. The year after, again. Relovation grew from there organically, not from a plan, but from the music and the people around it.
That is still the difference. We play together because we want to, not because we were put together. A room hears that difference, even if nobody can quite name it.
citaat: “We play together because we want to, not because we were put together.”

visie.intro: Relovation does not play music that asks for attention, but music that lifts the moment. Refined in timing, calm in presence, strong in atmosphere.

punten.tekst: Never too much, always exactly enough. We read the room and play to it.
Your programme sets the music, not the other way around. We follow the rhythm of your evening.
A repertoire that does not age, delivered with class and without distance.

muzikanten.intro: Four musicians, each with their own stage outside Relovation. Together they form the sound Relovation stands for.

leden.bio: Robin picked up the saxophone at eight and never put it down. As a finalist of The Voice van Vlaanderen 2021 and as a singer on stages such as the Queen Elisabeth Hall, with the Radio 2 Ratpack and the VRT Bigband, he brings a level you hear from the first note.
Lorenzo studied at Codarts Rotterdam and has been there from the very beginning. His piano playing is the reason Relovation ever started.
Tim lays the foundation everything rests on. As bassist of Meltheads, finalist of De Nieuwe Lichting, runner-up at Humo’s Rock Rally, Pukkelpop, he knows what it takes to get a room moving.
Joppe studied at Codarts Rotterdam and leads his own quartet. He knows exactly when a room needs a push, and when it does not.

muzikanten.noot: Depending on your event we play as a duo, trio or full band. Every line-up is a choice, not a compromise, and we are glad to advise which one suits your moment.

werkwijze.intro: Musical level is the beginning. The rest matters just as much, and that is where you notice us least.

punten.tekst: We agree repertoire, line-up, volume and timing before the day itself. No surprises.
Professional system for events up to ±250 guests, included.
We arrive on time, the soundcheck runs without fuss, and your venue barely notices us.
From experience we advise on what works at which moment. You do not have to work out the music yourself.

cta.tekst: A few short questions about your event. We personally look at which formula fits and send you a no-obligation proposal, tailored to you.
